title: ATP transparency-log consistency proof (section 5.5)
description: Structural schema for the section 5.5 consistency-proof response, derived from that section with the atp-conformance transparency-consistency-proof-valid fixture as ground truth. Verification is two byte rules the verifier enforces: both embedded signed tree heads verify per section 5.6, and the RFC 9162 section 2.1.4.2 algorithm over consistencyPath reproduces both rootHash values.

consistencyPath.description: RFC 6962 section 2.1.2 PROOF(m, D[n]). Empty only when fromSize equals toSize.
